legend.F: the fire (the Hearth block itself; row 4, column 4, layer 0 only)
legend.w: wood shape: stairs, slabs, fences, gates, trapdoors
legend.c: copper block or cut copper, any oxidation, waxed or not
legend.v: water source block (a waterlogged block does NOT count)
legend.V: lava source block (forge and demonic lanes only; never under or beside anything flammable)
legend.x: storage: chest, trapped chest or barrel
legend.G: glass: any glass, stained or tinted glass block, or pane
legend.I: packed ice or blue ice (not plain ice, which melts near the Hearth light)
